params.body:
An open row on the Accounts page showed two lines between the row and its panel: the row's cells keep their bottom border and the panel's first field opens with a top border.

An open row's cells now drop their bottom border, so the panel's own line is the only one. Build ok, lint ratchet at its ceiling, 29 e2e pass.
params.title: Accounts: one line under an open row
